mcqs.question: Read the following excerpt intended for a newspaper advertisement for a new fitness centre: "Join us now! Our state‑of‑the‑art gym, friendly trainers, and unbeatable prices will transform your health." Which option best reflects an appropriate persuasive tone for this advertisement?

options.B: Experience a healthier you with our modern facilities and expert trainers at a price you can afford.

mcqs.answer: Experience a healthier you with our modern facilities and expert trainers at a price you can afford.
mcqs.explanation: Option B uses an enthusiastic, persuasive tone, directly addresses the reader, and highlights benefits, which is essential for an effective advertisement. Options A and C are bland and lack persuasion, while D is vague and does not convey a compelling call to action.

mcqs.question: Rohit wants to sell his second‑hand bicycle. He writes the notice: "Bicycle for sale, good condition, Rs. 1500, contact Rohit." Which type of classified advertisement does this represent?
mcqs.explanation: Classified ads are short notices placed under specific headings. A notice offering an item for sale falls under the "Sale advertisement" category. The other options describe different kinds of notices.

mcqs.question: Which of the following pieces of information is NOT necessary in a newspaper advertisement for a new coffee shop?
mcqs.explanation: An effective advertisement must provide the name, location, and operating hours so readers can visit. The owner's personal preference, such as favorite color, does not help the reader and is therefore unnecessary.

mcqs.question: Select the most concise version of the given sentence for an advertisement: "We are delighted to inform you that our store will be offering a special discount of twenty percent on all items this weekend only."

options.A: Our store offers a 20% discount on all items this weekend.
options.B: We are delighted to inform you that our store will be offering a special discount of twenty percent on all items this weekend only.
options.C: Special discount of twenty percent on all items this weekend at our store, please come.
options.D: Discount! 20% off everything this weekend at our store.

mcqs.answer: Our store offers a 20% discount on all items this weekend.
mcqs.explanation: Option A conveys the essential information—what, how much, and when—in a clear, brief sentence. Options B and C are wordy, and D, while short, uses an informal exclamation that may reduce clarity.

mcqs.question:
Two draft advertisements for a shoe sale are shown below. Which draft organizes the information most effectively?

Draft 1: "SuperSale! Shoes - 50% off. Shoes are comfortable. Visit today."
Draft 2: "SuperSale on Shoes:
• 50% off
• Comfortable designs
• Visit our store at 5 PM"
Draft 3: "Huge discount on shoes. Come now."
Draft 4: "Shoes discount."
mcqs.explanation: Draft 2 uses bullet points to separate key details—offer, product benefit, and call‑to‑action—making it easy for readers to scan quickly. Draft 1 mixes ideas in a single line, while Drafts 3 and 4 are too brief and omit essential details.

mcqs.question: In a public‑service advertisement urging people to conserve water, which tone is most appropriate?
mcqs.explanation: A public‑service message needs to convey seriousness and prompt immediate action; an authoritative, urgent tone achieves this. Sarcasm or humor may undermine the seriousness, and indifference fails to motivate change.

mcqs.question: What is a classified advertisement?

options.B: A short notice placed under a specific heading to inform about a sale, job, or service

mcqs.answer: A short notice placed under a specific heading to inform about a sale, job, or service
mcqs.explanation: Classified ads are brief, categorized notices that convey information such as sales, vacancies, or services. They are not lengthy articles, personal letters, or poems.

mcqs.question: Which piece of information must always be included in an advertisement for a training workshop?

options.B: Date and time of the workshop
options.D: Number of chairs in the room

mcqs.answer: Date and time of the workshop
mcqs.explanation: The date and time tell the audience when the workshop will take place, which is essential for attendance. Personal preferences or interior details are irrelevant for the advertisement's purpose.
